invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new Pair object wrapping two non-null stat objects.
The returned Pair's left element (partitionPathStatMap) is always instantiated and never null.
The returned Pair's right element (globalStat) is always instantiated and never null.
The method assumes inputRecords is provided and uses it directly.
partitionPathStatMap is a HashMap and thus its size is always at least zero.
